rv.q: From start to finish, The Oil Lamp's production of Jeffrey Hatcher's adaptation of Alfred Hitchcock's classic thriller is a first-rate mystery.

Oil Lamp Theater transforms a familiar classic into an edge of your seat experience - one that rewards Hitchcock devotees, satisfies whodunnit purists, and proves that some mysteries are even better when you can feel the strain in the room. It's outstanding.
Fine acting, an imaginative set and clever lighting and sound make this revision of the classic 1951 play genuinely thrilling and a lot of fun.
Oil Lamp's production moves briskly, but it fails to tingle the spine. Still, King's cast delivers.
Oil Lamp Theater in Glenview has found the recipe to hold you spellbound for 2 hours and 15 minutes with Jeffrey Hatcher's adaptation of Frederick Knott's 'Dial M For Murder'.
The casting feels perfect as each of these actors embodies their character and makes us feel the tension between all of them and the situation they find themselves in.
